description: Short real-run smoke for 15_mocov2: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. The override keys match this method's config schema (train.img_size); train.queue_size is shrunk so the momentum queue stays consistent with the tiny batch on a few images.
